name: Mary-Jo Corporate Events
tagline: A static client site with a branded contact form that posts to Google Apps Script.
description: A static Nuxt, Vue and TypeScript website for a corporate events business. The branded contact form is built into the static site and posts to a Google Apps Script web app in production, with a local fallback route for development. Typecheck, lint, unit and end-to-end tests.
highlights: Serverless contact form via Apps Script
